feature: Transport-key retirement, discovery failure pacing and independent path migration

runtime_changes.key_retirement: SessionPool retirement removes expired current/previous entries; DataPlane::maintain checks monotonic time and retires entries; Network::tick invokes it before handshake-route cleanup. Existing 180-second acceptance lifetime is unchanged.
runtime_changes.discovery_probe_errors: Discard only Destination::Probe packets on non-WouldBlock errors. Preserve WouldBlock packets and other destination kinds, including selected application packets that can fall back to DERP. Pending discovery transaction expires normally; fresh scheduler attempts retain existing bounds.

discovery_probe_errors.failure: failed probe retained for immediate retry

new_regression_coverage: Idle polling releases initiator and responder transport-key owner tokens at expiry without new traffic or map revocation.
Previous receive-key owner expires at its original deadline; newer session remains usable and final retirement releases capacity.
WouldBlock retains the identical probe; a definitive failure discards it; repeated polls do not resend it; the scheduler later creates a new transaction.
